messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert — elevated 5xx and timeout rates on inference-gateway.prod. p95 jumped from ~1800ms to ~3600ms, p99 from ~2900ms to ~9200ms after the v2.4.1 deploy at 12:34 UTC. Error rate (5xx) > 4% for the last 4m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream.

eva (oncall): acked — I'm on it. Paging SRE.

priya (eng-sre): joining. Seeing steady increase in connection timeouts: `upstream error: timeout after 10s` from inference-proxy logs. Could be a kernel/quantization path on the new model build.

raj (infra): checking infra metrics — GPU utilization looks normal on nodes, but pod restarts spiked on the gateway deploy group. Rolling restarts started at 12:33 UTC.

laura (product-support): customers reporting timeouts in EU region. CS is collecting tickets, any quick mitigation?

priya (eng-sre): quick plan: 1) divert traffic away from canary pool 2) enable fallback to previous model variant 3) if still bad, rollback the deploy.

eva (oncall): diverting traffic now — enabling route weight 0 -> canary via routing service.

deploy-bot: Routing change applied: inference-gateway/canary weight -> 0% (user: eva).

priya (eng-sre): enabling model fallback policy to legacy-quant v2.3.8 for failing requests (prefix fallback). Command: `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --service inference-gateway --from v2.4.1 --to v2.3.8`

priya (eng-sre): logs after fallback enable:
```
[2025-06-10T12:38:10Z] INFO request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate fallback=legacy-quant latency=450ms
[2025-06-10T12:38:12Z] WARN request_id=def456 upstream_error=timeout after 10s
[2025-06-10T12:38:15Z] INFO metrics 5xx_rate=2.1% p95=1.2s p99=3.1s
```

eva (oncall): fallback reduced errors but p99 still noisy. We should prepare rollback.

raj (infra): I can do a control-plane rollback of the gateway deploy if you want. Revisions available: v2.4.0 (stable), v2.4.1 (current).

priya (eng-sre): yes, roll back to v2.4.0. Use redwoodctl first, then confirm with `kubectl`.

priya (eng-sre): rollback command: `redwoodctl deploy rollback --service inference-gateway --to-version v2.4.0 --reason "timeout regression after v2.4.1"`

raj (infra): executing now.

deploy-bot: Deploy rollback initiated by raj. Target version: v2.4.0. Rollback ID: rb-20250610-001.

raj (infra): running `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway -n prod --to-revision=1234` then `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=inference-gateway -o wide`.

priya (eng-sre): monitoring metrics and traces. Observability: sampling tail traces on p99 to verify root cause. Initial traces show long kernel launch times and KV cache misses for new quant path.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback completed. inference-gateway now at v2.4.0 (rb-20250610-001). Traffic restored to stable fleet.

priya (eng-sre): after rollback metrics: 5xx rate down to 0.4%, p95 ~1900ms, p99 ~3000ms, continuing to trend down. We'll keep an eye for 15m.

laura (product-support): CS: Notifying affected customers with an incident update. Impact window estimate: ~12:34–12:52 UTC (~18 minutes). Potentially elevated 504s for some EU customers.

eva (oncall): SLO impact: brief breach on tail latency for ~2 windows. Logging incident for postmortem. Assigning primary: priya, infra: raj, customer comms: laura.

priya (eng-sre): next steps: capture p99 traces for v2.4.1, repro in staging, add a short fuzz test for kernel latency on quant path, and disable auto-promote until validated.

laura (product-support): I've posted the customer-facing note in #customer-updates and created a ticket list. Will handoff to morning shift for follow-ups.

eva (oncall): handing off to priya for on-call coverage. priya — take it. I'll stay available for escalation.

priya (eng-sre): taking over. I/O: collecting debug artifacts, container images, and failure logs (pushed to s3://redwood-incidents/1918203333/). Will start a formal postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager resolved. Duration: 0:19:46. Incident severity: Sev2.

priya (eng-sre): thanks team. If anyone sees regressions re-open this thread.
